review.assessment:
The task requires fixing `deepClone` so that nested objects and arrays are recursively cloned, making the copy fully independent of the original. The diff replaces the shallow array mapping (`map((v) => v)`) with recursive application (`map((v) => deepClone(v))`) and swaps the object spread operator for a key-iteration loop that also applies `deepClone` to each property value. This exactly covers the stated scope of recursively cloning nested objects and arrays without altering primitive handling or introducing unrelated changes.

The change replaces shallow copying with recursive traversal for both arrays and plain objects, ensuring every level is cloned independently while leaving primitives untouched as intended.
